title: tc-decision-card
description:
One question an agent needs answered before it carries on – numbered options with one recommended, or Approve /
Decline – docked above the composer, folding into a receipt with Undo once sent.

agent.description: Who is asking: the agent's name

avatar.description: The agent's picture (an image URL); unset shows its initials

question.description: The question, as the agent asks it

context.description: A line or two of context: what the agent found, why it can't go on alone

options.description: The options for kind="choose", in the agent's order

allowOther.description: Offers "Something else…" with a short field

value.description: The picked option's id ("other" for Something else), or null

since.description: When the agent asked, in epoch ms – the header says how long it has waited

now.description: The time now, in epoch ms; unset reads the clock, once a minute

queue.description: How many decisions wait in all; above 1 the header shows "1 of 3" with previous / next

position.description: Which of the waiting decisions this is, from 0

sent.description: Sent: the card shows its receipt

decision.description: What was sent – the receipt reads it

undoMs.description: How long Undo stays on the receipt, in ms (0 hides it)

labels.description: Words the page can change, merged over defaultDecisionCardLabels

detail.description: A quiet line under the label: what this option means or costs

recommended.description: The agent's suggestion – at most one; shows a Recommended chip and takes the first focus
